An approved code had legal effect only through section 3 (under 3(b) its provisions became the standards of fair competition, under 3(c) the district courts could enjoin violations, under 3(f) violations were misdemeanors). Section 2 of S.J. The approval therefore ceased to have operative effect on June 14, 1935. No held record shows this code cancelled or suspended earlier, and June 16, 1935 is not an end because section 1 of the resolution replaced that expiry with April 1, 1936.
